summary: Frontend-only testing of the 3 new cross-cutting features (search boxes, view toggle, Indonesian thousand separators). Found 2 CRITICAL runtime errors that make the Produk and Supplier pages fully non-functional (blank white screen after login). All other pages tested (Pelanggan, Kategori, Pengguna, Pesanan, Pembelian, Inventory, Pengeluaran) work: search filters correctly reduce list on typing and restore on clear; ViewToggle on Kategori/Pelanggan switches modes and persists in localStorage across reload; NumberInput on Expenses formats 1500000 -> 1.500.000 correctly. NOTE: Review request lists route paths in English (/products, /customers, /categories, ...) but actual React Router uses Indonesian paths (/produk, /pelanggan, /kategori, /supplier, /pengguna, /pesanan, /pembelian, /pengeluaran). Only /inventory and /pos are English. Testing was done against the actual Indonesian routes.

ui_bugs.issue: PAGE CRASHES: PageError 'view is not defined'. Products.jsx imports { ViewToggle, useViewMode } from ViewToggle.jsx but never calls useViewMode. Lines 114 and 167 reference `view` and `setView` which are undefined. The entire Produk page renders blank. Blocks: product-search, view-toggle, product-grid, product-card-*, NumberInput on Harga Jual/Stok, and add-product flow.

PAGE CRASHES: PageError 'useViewMode is not defined'. Suppliers.jsx uses `const [view, setView] = useViewMode(...)` at line 18 and <ViewToggle .../> at line 49, but is missing the import `import { ViewToggle, useViewMode } from '@/components/ViewToggle';`. Entire Supplier page renders blank. Blocks supplier-search, view-toggle, supplier-* items.

search_boxes.customer-search: OK - 201->1 (only wrapper) on nomatch, restored to 201 on clear
search_boxes.category-search: OK - 52->0 on nomatch, restored to 52 on clear
search_boxes.inventory-search: OK - 3->1 rows on nomatch, restored to 3 on clear

view_toggle.Pelanggan (view-customers): besar/kecil/list all render items; localStorage updated correctly (besar/kecil/list)
view_toggle.Kategori (view-categories): OK all three modes; persistence across reload verified (set 'kecil' -> reload -> ls='kecil', view-kecil button retains active bg-primary class)

number_input.pay-cash-input / deposit / po qty / stoc: Not fully exercised end-to-end because Produk page crash blocks Products add-product NumberInput test; recommend re-test after fix

action_items: Fix Products.jsx: add `const [view, setView] = useViewMode('view-products', 'list');` inside the component (useViewMode is already imported but never called).
Fix Suppliers.jsx: add missing import `import { ViewToggle, useViewMode } from '@/components/ViewToggle';` at the top (used at lines 18 and 49 without import).

Re-test Products page for: product-search, view-toggle modes (besar/kecil showing product-grid + product-card-<id>, list showing table), localStorage key 'view-products' default 'list' and persistence, and NumberInput on product-price-input / product-stock-input (typing 1500000 -> 1.500.000, save persists raw 1500000).
Re-test Supplier page for supplier-search filter + view toggle three modes and persistence (key view-suppliers, default 'besar').
Optional deeper test after fix: POS full checkout with pay-cash-input formatted input to confirm receipt total is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Products.jsx & Suppliers.jsx crashes are caused by trivial oversights (unused import + missing declaration in Products; missing import in Suppliers) — a lint check (no-undef) or a smoke test after implementation would have caught both immediately.
ViewToggle.jsx useViewMode hook has a subtle React SSR concern (localStorage accessed in useState initializer) — OK for CRA runtime but worth noting.
NumberInput.jsx correctly emits raw Number via onValueChange — verified visually on expense-amount-input.

success_rate.frontend: ~65% (7 of 9 pages pass, 2 pages crash blocking Product/Supplier feature verification)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Actual routes are Indonesian: /produk /pelanggan /kategori /supplier /pengguna /pesanan /pembelian /pengeluaran (only /inventory and /pos are English). Auth uses AuthContext with token likely in memory but survived page.goto reloads (localStorage token seen). When re-testing Products after fix, also verify default mode is 'list' (table view) — this is the only page whose default is 'list'; others default to 'besar'. Expenses NumberInput was verified end-to-display but not saved to backend in this run.
rca of the issue: Products.jsx: importer was added (`import { ViewToggle, useViewMode } from ...`) and JSX references to `view`/`setView` were added, but the hook call `const [view, setView] = useViewMode('view-products', 'list')` was omitted. Results in ReferenceError at first render. Suppliers.jsx: opposite — the hook call and JSX use were added but the import statement was never added. Both are single-line fixes.
